property_summary: For any caller whose Bank.supportsToken() returns keccak256("Nu Token") and whose tokenBalance is zero, airDrop must succeed and increase that caller's tokenBalance by 20; the mutant hard-codes a wrong hash so airDrop reverts for every legitimate caller.
change_summary: Change the supportsToken modifier's hash comparison to use a different literal string, so the token-support check no longer matches Nu Token.
